caveat: Entity-level SOC statement lines for Port Authority of NSW only. Never add to government program spending, to the PNFC sector benchmark, or to each other: the statement prints an explicit Total revenue and Total expenses; total revenue already includes all revenue lines, total expenses already includes employee, depreciation/amortisation, other expenses and finance costs; the net result is a profit. No government grants/contributions are separately disclosed in this statement or its notes, so no grants row is emitted. Provisional and unverified.
notes: Latest Port Authority of NSW annual report discovered from the official annual-reports page (no hard-coded PDF URL) and archived with SHA-256 outside the repo. The Statement of comprehensive income prints an explicit $'000 unit and explicit Total revenue and Total expenses subtotals. Both printed totals are accepted only when the printed revenue and expense lines, the profit-before-tax bridge (including net gain on sale of PPE and other gains), the net-result bridge and the Note 3/Note 4 printed totals reconcile exactly. No government grants/contributions are separately disclosed, so no grant row is emitted. Every row is a provisional, unverified entity-level SOC statement line (jurisdiction_level=soc, aggregation_role=agency_detail); never add Port Authority of NSW rows to government program spending, the PNFC benchmark, or any other SOC.
